title: Journey to the West
author: Shénbǐ
description: The Monkey King and friends from the classic novel: his golden staff, his somersault cloud, peaches of immortality and a demon's gourd for your world, the heroes' names, the birth of the stone monkey as a short book, and 14 sentences to read.

words.hint: 悟空 means 'awake to emptiness', a name his Buddhist teacher gave him.
唐 the Tang dynasty + 僧 monk.
He starts with 猪 pig (you know it): a lazy, greedy pig-man.
沙 sand + 僧 monk: he lived in a river of sand.

words.en: master; teacher (what the disciples call Tang Seng)
words.hint: 师 as in 老师 + 父 father: a teacher like a father.
妖 has 女 inside: many demons in the story disguise as pretty girls.
石 stone (as in 石头) + 猴 monkey (as in 猴子).

words.en: the Western Heaven (India, where the scriptures are)

words.hint: 金 gold + 箍 hoop + 棒 stick. It can shrink to a needle he keeps in his ear.
筋斗 somersault + 云 cloud (you know it): one somersault carries him 108,000 li.
桃 peach has 木 (tree) on the left.
Both have 艹 on top: a gourd is a plant.

words.en: palm-leaf fan (it blows out a burning mountain)
words.hint: 芭蕉 banana plant + 扇 fan.
经 scripture + 书 book (you know it).
取 to fetch + 经 scriptures: the whole journey is for this.
Sun Wukong knows 72 ways to 变.
Say it with a thumbs-up: 太厉害了! 'So awesome!'

books.title: 石猴
books.blurb: How the Monkey King was born from a stone (from the classic novel).

pages.en: Long, long ago, on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, there was a stone.
tokens: the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit

pages.en: One day the stone cracked open, and out jumped a monkey.
This was the stone monkey. He was small, but very formidable.
The stone monkey learned the 72 transformations. He could turn into a bird, into a fish, or even into a tree.
He also had a somersault cloud. One somersault: 108,000 li!
His golden staff could grow big, and could shrink small.
He called himself "the Great Sage Equal to Heaven".
tokens: the Great Sage Equal to Heaven

pages.en: Later he protected Tang Seng on the journey to the Western Heaven to fetch the scriptures.
tokens: the Western Heaven (India, where the scriptures are)

pages.en: Their road was long, and there were many demons. But Sun Wukong wasn't afraid!

sentences.en: Sun Wukong has the golden staff.
Tang Seng is on the journey for the scriptures.
Sun Wukong eats the peaches of immortality.
The peaches of immortality are big.
